notes: The title self-declares both genres — fighting simulator — and this is the stat-grind family, so Simulation leads and Action is named second rather than allowed to lead: punching, running, taking hits and charging aura are training stations, the six zones open on stat thresholds, and rebirth trades progress for a multiplier, which is the number going up being the game. That makes it tier-ladder and Stat Grinder rather than an arena, and it keeps the build on P0 instead of importing a combat genre's shape. The author's answers are what hold it there: the six zones are connected ground walked between rather than teleported into, each compact and arena-sized, so this is one continuous surface and not the P4 multi-zone read the zone list would otherwise invite. Action contributes spawner-npc for the per-zone enemies and bosses, and I added path-circulation for the walked-between ground; the separate PvP arenas the author asked for sit as another area on that same surface rather than a separate map, and the leaderboards, shop UI, inventory, auras and VFX are all interface rather than layout.
